headline: Trump Restarts Battle to Fire Sitting Fed Governor Lisa Cook
context: The Trump administration, rebuffed by the Supreme Court in its first attempt to fire Lisa D. Cook, sent the Federal Reserve governor a letter saying it was “considering” removing her from the job.

sources.name: The New York Times
